actions.description: Grants permission to alter various aspects of the cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's ALTER CLUSTER ACL
actions.name: AlterCluster

actions.description: Grants permission to alter the dynamic configuration of a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's ALTER_CONFIGS CLUSTER ACL
actions.name: AlterClusterDynamicConfiguration

actions.description: Grants permission to join groups on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's READ GROUP ACL
actions.name: AlterGroup

actions.description: Grants permission to alter topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's ALTER TOPIC ACL
actions.name: AlterTopic

actions.description: Grants permission to alter the dynamic configuration of topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's ALTER_CONFIGS TOPIC ACL
actions.name: AlterTopicDynamicConfiguration

actions.description: Grants permission to alter transactional IDs on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's WRITE TRANSACTIONAL_ID ACL
actions.name: AlterTransactionalId

actions.description: Grants permission to connect and authenticate to the cluster
actions.name: Connect

actions.description: Grants permission to create topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's CREATE CLUSTER/TOPIC ACL
actions.name: CreateTopic

actions.description: Grants permission to delete groups on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DELETE GROUP ACL
actions.name: DeleteGroup

actions.description: Grants permission to delete topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DELETE TOPIC ACL
actions.name: DeleteTopic

actions.description: Grants permission to describe various aspects of the cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DESCRIBE CLUSTER ACL
actions.name: DescribeCluster

actions.description: Grants permission to describe the dynamic configuration of a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DESCRIBE_CONFIGS CLUSTER ACL
actions.name: DescribeClusterDynamicConfiguration

actions.description: Grants permission to describe groups on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DESCRIBE GROUP ACL
actions.name: DescribeGroup

actions.description: Grants permission to describe topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DESCRIBE TOPIC ACL
actions.name: DescribeTopic

actions.description: Grants permission to describe the dynamic configuration of topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DESCRIBE_CONFIGS TOPIC ACL
actions.name: DescribeTopicDynamicConfiguration

actions.description: Grants permission to describe transactional IDs on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's DESCRIBE TRANSACTIONAL_ID ACL
actions.name: DescribeTransactionalId

actions.description: Grants permission to read data from topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's READ TOPIC ACL
actions.name: ReadData

actions.description: Grants permission to write data to topics on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's WRITE TOPIC ACL
actions.name: WriteData

actions.description: Grants permission to write data idempotently on a cluster, equivalent to Apache Kafka's IDEMPOTENT_WRITE CLUSTER ACL
actions.name: WriteDataIdempotently

conditions.description: Filters actions based on tag key-value pairs attached to the resource. The resource tag context key will only apply to the cluster resource, not topics, groups and transactional IDs

service_name: Apache Kafka APIs for Amazon MSK clusters
